description: This file contains test suite functions for verifying the contract compliance of various provider plugins (web search, web fetch, and general provider plugins) in the openclaw project. It defines functions that run assertions on provider objects to ensure they meet expected interface and behavior standards.

methods.name: installProviderPluginContractSuite
methods.description: Sets up tests to verify that a ProviderPlugin adheres to the base provider plugin contract, including validation of IDs, labels, auth methods, wizard setup, and model allowlist.

methods.name: installWebSearchProviderContractSuite
methods.description: Sets up tests to verify that a WebSearchProviderPlugin complies with the web search provider contract, including credential handling and tool creation.

methods.name: installWebFetchProviderContractSuite
methods.description: Sets up tests to verify that a WebFetchProviderPlugin complies with the web fetch provider contract, including credential management, URL validation, and tool creation.
